subject: physiology
title: Thyroid hormones

steps.tx: The **thyroid gland** stores hormone in follicular colloid: iodide trapped by the sodium iodide symporter, oxidised and organified by thyroid peroxidase onto thyroglobulin, coupled from MIT and DIT into thyroxine T4 prohormone and active T3 liothyronine, converted peripherally by deiodinase, driven by pituitary TSH under hypothalamic TRH and suppressed by T3 feedback. Pendrin transports iodide, excess iodide blocks release by Wolff Chaikoff effect, and goitre swells from deficiency or excess. Follicles therefore store weeks of hormone.
steps.say: Follicles trap iodide, peroxidase organifies it onto thyroglobulin, and coupling builds mostly thyroxine with a little active triiodothyronine, stored in colloid as the synthesis figure shows. Pituitary thyroid stimulating hormone drives the gland and hormone feeds back to switch it off, while peripheral deiodinases activate thyroxine where needed. Excess iodide briefly blocks release, peroxidase is the carbimazole target, and the gland swells as goitre when drive persists.

vis.alt: Steps of thyroid hormone synthesis: iodide trapping by the sodium iodide symporter, oxidation and organification by thyroid peroxidase onto thyroglobulin, coupling of MIT and DIT into T3 and T4 in colloid, then endocytosis and proteolysis releasing T4 and T3.
vis.caption: Trap, oxidise, organify, couple, store, then endocytose and release; thyroid peroxidase is the target of carbimazole.

steps.tx: Thyroid **hormone action** raises basal metabolic rate and oxygen use, generates heat with sweating, upregulates beta receptors toward tremor, matures bones and brains for growth, speeds gut motility, lowers LDL cholesterol, and climbs heart rate and contractility. Iodine lack in neonates stunts as cretinism, heel screening catches TSH early, maternal low thyroxine harms intelligence, and myxoedema flags low hormone as coarse dry and slow. Hormones therefore burn fuel while building brains in infancy and childhood development daily.
steps.say: Thyroid hormone sets the idle speed of the body: metabolism and heat rise, beta receptors multiply so the heart races and hands tremble, bowels speed, and cholesterol falls, system by system in the actions table. In infancy it is irreplaceable for brain and bone growth, so heel screening and maternal sufficiency protect intelligence. Too little slows everything into coarse dry myxoedema, the opposite pole of thyrotoxic heat.

vis.alt: Table of thyroid hormone actions by system: raises basal metabolic rate and heat production, upregulates beta receptors, essential for fetal and childhood brain and bone growth, speeds gut motility.
vis.caption: Thyroid hormone raises metabolism, heat, heart rate and gut motility; in infancy it is essential for brain development.

steps.tx: **Hyperthyroidism** in Graves disease follows thyroid stimulating immunoglobulin antibodies with lid lag and exophthalmos eyes, pretibial myxoedema plaques, and storm fever with agitation near forty two degrees, blocked in synthesis by carbimazole risking rashes, propylthiouracil in first pregnancy, ablated by radioiodine avoiding pregnancy, and resected subtotally watching nerves and parathyroids. Thyroiditis burns tenderly with high ESR in de Quervain or silently and painlessly postpartum, while propranolol beta blockade calms tremor and rate. Antibodies therefore overdrive the gland until blocked.
steps.say: Stimulating antibodies in Graves disease switch the gland fully on and uniquely inflame eyes and shins, while storm decompensates with fever and agitation, features tabled in the Graves figure. Carbimazole blocks synthesis, propylthiouracil serves early pregnancy, radioiodine ablates, and surgery watches the recurrent nerve and parathyroids. Painful tender thyroiditis with high sedimentation rate and painless postpartum thyroiditis are burning out transiently, and beta blockers are calming tremor meanwhile.

vis.alt: Table of Graves disease features: thyroid stimulating antibodies, eye signs of lid lag and exophthalmos, pretibial myxoedema, thyroid storm with fever and agitation, and carbimazole or propylthiouracil treatment.
vis.caption: Graves disease: TSH receptor stimulating antibodies; only Graves has eye disease and pretibial myxoedema.

steps.tx: **Hypothyroidism** follows Hashimoto thyroid peroxidase antibodies with a firm gland, worldwide iodine deficiency, lithium and amiodarone drugs, and myxoedema coma cold and bradycardic after precipitants, replaced by levothyroxine mornings empty titrated to TSH, watched as subclinical high TSH with normal T4, prevented as cretinism by neonatal screening, and started low slowly in the elderly. Tests read TSH first high or low, free T4 confirming, TPO and thyroglobulin antibodies binding, while statin myopathy mimics aches. Glands therefore fail slowly until replaced.
steps.say: Primary gland failure raises thyroid stimulating hormone while free thyroxine falls, the first row of the patterns table, most often autoimmune Hashimoto disease with peroxidase antibodies or worldwide iodine lack. Levothyroxine on an empty stomach titrated to stimulating hormone replaces it, started gently in elderly hearts, while subclinical disease only watches. Lithium and amiodarone can induce failure, statin aches can imitate it, and missed neonatal disease costs intelligence.

vis.alt: Table of thyroid function test patterns: primary hypothyroidism high TSH low free T4, subclinical high TSH normal T4, secondary hypothyroidism low or normal TSH low T4, Graves disease low TSH high T4, rare TSH producing adenoma high TSH high T4.
vis.caption: Read TSH first: high TSH with low T4 is primary hypothyroidism; low TSH with high T4 is primary hyperthyroidism.
